turn-steering.title: Add context to the original execution
turn-steering.loading: Checking the original message and current execution target…
turn-steering.empty: No sendable original execution target is currently available. Read the exact context again.
turn-steering.refresh_failed: The current steering context could not be read. Read the original message again.
turn-steering.invalid_read: The steering context could not be verified. Read it again.
turn-steering.intent_unavailable: The original steering intent could not be verified. Preserve it and check the current scope.
turn-steering.access_denied: Current access changed. The original message and execution context are no longer displayed.
turn-steering.original_pending: The original platform submission is unconfirmed. Recover the same request before changing targets, operation keys or dispatching again.
turn-steering.background_paused: Background reading is paused. Explicitly refresh the original context.
turn-steering.stale: The current context has not been confirmed again. Refresh before selecting and sending.
turn-steering.boundary: Add your saved message to the same live turn only. This creates no turn, resumes no session and changes no original model, budget or plan.
turn-steering.no_credentials: Do not send secrets or credentials through discussion. Use the original secure configuration flow.
turn-steering.reason.not_own_message: Only your own saved human message can be sent explicitly. Do not send another person's, API or assistant message on their behalf.
turn-steering.reason.task_accepted: The task has been formally accepted. Continue through a new iteration requirement.
turn-steering.reason.no_live_turn: No attested original live turn is available. A running node alone does not permit sending.
turn-steering.reason.current_execution_u: Current execution eligibility is unavailable. Check the original task, node and run facts.
turn-steering.choose_target: Explicitly choose the original execution target
turn-steering.session_active: Live turn registered; this alone does not establish online status
turn-steering.already_saved: This message was already submitted to this original session and cannot be sent again.
turn-steering.context_details: View message source and target basis
turn-steering.delivery.saved: The platform saved the additional instruction.
turn-steering.delivery.observed: The Runner observed the original instruction.
turn-steering.delivery.written: The native instruction was fully written.
turn-steering.delivery.accepted: The native service accepted the original instruction.
turn-steering.delivery.rejected: The native service explicitly rejected the original instruction. This is not an unknown result to blindly resend.
turn-steering.delivery.not_written: The matching original session closed before this instruction started writing.
turn-steering.delivery.unknown: The original delivery observation needs reconciliation. Preserve the same instruction and operation; do not resend the native request or create a new turn.
turn-steering.acceptance_boundary: Native acceptance does not prove model compliance, code quality, passing tests or human acceptance.
turn-steering.instruction_details: View original instruction and delivery evidence
